inline_text:
This adds the authority-at-dispatch comparison from [issue 13](https://github.com/aaif/wg-identity-and-trust/issues/13) as a catalogue entry, a workflow that runs it, and an agenda item.

Every trace in the comparison writes one versioned contract identifier, and the reader refuses a trace without it. Authority evidence also carries its age and the deployed freshness limit Imran Siddique asked the comparison to keep in [message 26](https://lists.aaif.io/g/wg-identity-trust/message/26). The entry maps the six cases from [list message 14](https://lists.aaif.io/g/wg-identity-trust/message/14) onto reference cases and pins the MintID, Proofable and Alakris runs from issue 13.

The workflow installs the reader from [agent-evidence-observer](https://github.com/probityai/agent-evidence-observer) at a pinned commit, runs the reference cases, and refuses a submitted trace without the identifier. I'm happy to maintain it. Could the chairs give the item 10 to 15 minutes at the Thursday, October 15 meeting, next to the delegated-authority cases from message 14?
